_doc: DEMO — import transform examples. All 'transform' expressions use the variable 'value' which holds the raw (stripped) string read from the file. This format_id is for reference only; the target_table columns below may not all exist in a real table.
name: Transform Examples — Import (Demo)
description: Demonstrates every available transform category for fixed-length and delimited import. Not wired to a real file — copy any field block into a production rule.

fields.name: account_id
fields._comment: No transform: raw value is stored directly after whitespace stripping.

fields.name: product_code
fields._comment: ' loan ' → 'LOAN'  |  trim removes leading/trailing spaces, upper converts to uppercase.

fields.name: status_flag
fields._comment: '  ACTIVE  ' → 'active'

fields.name: description_field
fields._comment: Remove leading/trailing spaces only, keep original case.

fields.name: left_trim_only
fields._comment: Remove leading spaces only.

fields.name: right_trim_only
fields._comment: Remove trailing spaces only.

fields.name: org_unit_id
fields._comment: '12' → 'BR0012'  |  lpad zero-pads to 4 chars, concat prepends the 'BR' prefix.

fields.name: account_padded
fields._comment: '123' → '0000000123'  |  left-pad with zeros to total length 10.

fields.name: code_right_padded
fields._comment: 'ABC' → 'ABC     '  |  right-pad with spaces to total length 8.

fields.name: reference_code
fields._comment: '001' → 'REF-001-2026'  |  concat accepts any number of arguments.

fields.name: year_part
fields._comment: '20260101' → '2026'  |  left(v, n) keeps the first n characters.

fields.name: month_part
fields._comment: '20260101' → '01'  |  substr(v, start, end) — 0-based, end is exclusive.

fields.name: slice_syntax
fields._comment: Python slice syntax works the same way: value[0:8] keeps first 8 chars.

fields.name: last_4_chars
fields._comment: 'ACCT_1234' → '1234'  |  right(v, n) keeps the last n characters.

fields.name: clean_amount
fields._comment: '1,234,567' → '1234567'  |  remove thousands separators before numeric conversion.

fields.name: normalised_id
fields._comment: 'ACC-001 X' → 'ACC001X'  |  chain replace() calls to strip multiple characters.

fields.name: balance
fields._comment: Source stores balance in cents (integer); divide by 100 to get dollars. '25000000' → 250000.0

fields.name: rate_bps
fields._comment: Source stores rate in basis points; divide by 10000 to get decimal. '535' → 0.0535

fields.name: quantity
fields._comment: Strict integer parse — fails loudly if value is not a whole number. '42' → 42

fields.name: amount_rounded
fields._comment: Full pipeline: strip commas → convert → scale → round to 2 dp. '1,234,567' → 12345.67

fields.name: entry_type
fields._comment: Positive amount → 'DEBIT', negative → 'CREDIT'. Equivalent to SQL CASE WHEN.

fields.name: entry_type_iif
fields._comment: iif(condition, true_value, false_value) — same as the ternary above, Excel-style.

fields.name: risk_bucket
fields.transform: 'HIGH' if to_int(value) >= 80 else ('MED' if to_int(value) >= 50 else 'LOW')
fields._comment: Nested ternary for range mapping: 80+ → HIGH, 50-79 → MED, <50 → LOW.

fields.name: in_list_check
fields._comment: Set membership test: map approved product codes to 'Y', everything else to 'N'.

fields.name: not_in_list
fields._comment: Flag internal/test records; pass real values through unchanged.

fields.name: nullable_field
fields._comment: If value is blank/None after strip, return 'UNKNOWN'. Same as SQL NVL or ISNULL.

fields.name: priority_field
fields._comment: Returns the first non-null, non-empty argument. Useful when chaining multiple fallbacks.

fields.name: zero_for_blank
fields._comment: If the balance field is blank, default to 0 before converting to float.

fields.name: as_of_date_yyyymmdd
fields._comment: Parse YYYYMMDD (e.g. '20260101') → Python date 2026-01-01. No transform needed; use date_format.

fields.name: as_of_date_iso
fields._comment: Parse ISO date string '2026-01-01' (default format; date_format may be omitted).

fields.name: normalised_org
fields._comment: Step 1: trim spaces. Step 2: strip 'BR' prefix. Step 3: zero-pad to 4. Step 4: prepend 'OU-'. 'BR  7' → 'OU-0007'

fields.name: sign_adjusted_balance
fields._comment: Some sources suffix 'D' for debit (negative). Strip sign indicator and apply sign: '50000D' → -500.0

fields.name: masked_account
fields._comment: 'ACC-12345678' → 'ACC-****5678'  |  mask middle characters for display/audit fields.
